purpose: Predeclared companion analysis of five image queries from one cow/date/camera, fixed before baseline inference
input: Same frozen MobileNetV3-small embeddings and date/identity sample as identity_pilot_v1

methods.name: single_first
methods.query_vectors: First of five selected files by original filename

methods.name: mean_five
methods.query_vectors: Arithmetic mean of five L2-normalised embeddings, then L2 normalise

gallery: Same 20 known identities, five Aug14 images each; max cosine per identity
thresholds: For each method independently use Aug19 groups only and the original calibration selection rule; freeze before scoring Aug20 groups
group: Anonymous cow ID + day + camera1; these are public curated daily-tracklet proxies, not a newly verified visual passage or a real RF incident
statistics: Report each group once; unknown calibration10/evaluation10 are different IDs; empirical FAR<=0.05 permits zero false accepts out of10 calibration groups and has coarse resolution
scope: A fixed comparison, not a search for best K, cropping policy or quality threshold; no new training
